## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector leadership (Top 5 span Tech/Materials/Healthcare) and dispersion among megacaps (AAPL, MSFT BELOW TREND while AMD, INTC ABOVE TREND) — leadership concentrated but mixed (Leadership: Broad, 3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials leading: NEM (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND; Financials leading on select names: PNC (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing strength: UNH (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall (19 stocks) with major names AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND. Communication also weak: NFLX (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -11.49%) BELOW TREND; Real Estate showing weakness as well.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -17.22%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -2.10%) BELOW TREND; CHTR (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -6.01%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -12.24%) BELOW TREND; MMM (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -0.82%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +24.33%) ABOVE TREND; watch META (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY for follow-through. Note divergence: INTC trading up amid strongly negative sentiment (-60).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure with large-cap bifurcation; NVDA (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND but AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND. Expect selective strength in semiconductors (AMD, INTC, AMAT) but broader Tech remains fragile.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but constructive on a handful of names; PNC (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND while JPM (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -6.55%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation within the sector.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing bifurcation: UNH (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +1.49%) ABOVE TREND, versus ABT (1W: -12.67% | 1M: -12.99%) BELOW TREND; overall sector constructive but stock-specific risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Financials, Materials and Healthcare exposure given mixed-but-positive pockets (PNC, NEM, UNH). Reduce exposure to large-cap Tech acting BELOW TREND (AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +24.33%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND; ABT (1W: -12.67% | 1M: -12.99%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (NEM lead), Healthcare (UNH/GILD strength), Industrials (BA, CAT showing strength). BEARISH: Technology (broad pressure), Communication (NFLX, CHTR weakness), Real Estate (near-term softness).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND for hold and follow-through as a tech sentiment bellwether; AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim recent range would signal deeper weakness; INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND — monitor news flow vs sentiment for reversal risk; UNH (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%) ABOVE TREND — look for continuation above the 1M high.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (+55): ORCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price is falling (divergence). NVDA (+45): NVDA (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price broadly confirming. CRM (+45): CRM (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -12.24%) BELOW TREND — bullish narrative contrasts with weak price (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-60): INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but strong price action (divergence; watch for news-driven mean reversion). TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: -6.62%) RECOVERY — sentiment negative while short-term price bounces (watch follow-through). JPM (-45): JPM (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment mostly confirming price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed leadership; breadth 6/11 and leadership Broad (3 sectors) argue against a directional call, style mixed. AMD (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) ABOVE TREND are showing the strongest momentum while AAPL (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) and MSFT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%) are showing weakness. Key risk: sentiment-price divergences (INTC, ORCL, CRM, ABBV headlines) require monitoring — these are tactical signals, not confirmation of regime change.
